evidence_tier: REAL. WP2 Phase 5, the capstone: the frozen-certificate prospective test on the holdout environment (returns, built after the freeze, gates ALL PASS). Stage A computed the certificate's safe operating envelope from deployment-visible data only (artifacts/wp2env_7644a21fb970d7bd, recipe v2: 20 bins, audit C 1.0 ledgered benign, freshness precondition trivially satisfied because each level is audited against its own mix); THIS registration embeds those numbers as the predictions; stage B sweeps realized risk afterward. Nothing in stage B can change stage A's numbers.

predictions.P-P5-1: COVERAGE, the capstone claim: realized excess of the deployed pipeline (logistic ratio, full view, ledgered defaults) is at or below the registered bound_median at every one of the 12 (feature, beta) cells.
predictions.P-P5-2: PRICE, reported honestly: mean (bound_median - realized excess) across cells predicted <= 0.07; every cell's price reported.
predictions.P-P5-3: RISKY, the danger-location claim: the deployed arm's realized excess at serial_rate beta {5, 6} is POSITIVE (the ledgered C = 1.0 ratio shrinkage at exp(6)-scale tilts on a weak-proxy blind driver, the B4 mechanism, should produce real anti-conservatism there of order +0.005 to +0.02). Covering cells where nothing happens is cheap; this clause predicts where something happens.
predictions.P-P5-4: Oracle safety: the oracle arm is consistent-with-control (never VIOLATION at the one-sided z) at all 12 cells.

falsifiers.P-P5-1: Any breached cell is the paper's honest headline for the certificate's limits; per Phase 4 discipline it would be reported with its breach size and attack-surface diagnosis, not narrated away.
falsifiers.P-P5-3: If excess at the top serial levels is zero or negative, the weak-proxy reconstruction defended more than the B4 shrinkage hurt, and the danger-location model needs that correction on file.

decision_rule: 300 trials per cell, fresh seed 20260822 (stage B streams disjoint from stage A). Coverage against bound_median per cell as embedded above. Verdicts prediction-by-prediction, misses verbatim.
